stories.title: Ivanti Zero-Day Chain Gave Attackers Root Access to Fully Patched VPN
stories.description: CVE-2026-104935 affects Ivanti Connect Secure and it can be exploited for unauthenticated remote code execution with elevated privileges.

stories.title: Anthropic Warns Small AI Models Could Soon Form Self-Propagating IoT Botnets
stories.description: Anthropic warns small AI models could form IoT botnets; GLM-5.2 propagated Llama3.1-8B to eight nodes in four of five tests.

stories.title: Microsoft Fixes 1,118 Vulnerabilities in October Patch Tuesday and Introduces New Risk Cohorts
stories.description: Microsoft’s October 2026 Patch Tuesday briefing outlines 1,118 vulnerabilities across 15 risk groups, alongside a new approach designed to help security teams review large update releases.

stories.title: Docker Fixes Critical Two-Year-Old Hub Flaw That Let One User Push Images as Another
stories.description: Docker fixed a critical Hub account conversion flaw that let transferred tokens push images as other users; it found no evidence of exploitation.

stories.title: Critical FortiSandbox GUI Vulnerability Allows Remote Attackers to Bypass Authentication
stories.description: Fortinet has disclosed a critical authentication bypass vulnerability in the FortiSandbox graphical user interface that could allow remote attackers to access protected functions without valid credentials.

stories.title: Attacker Chains Three Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Days for Root Access, Only Two Patched So Far
stories.description: An attacker exploited three Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days to run commands as root and steal stored credentials from one appliance.

stories.title: SAP Discloses Critical CVSS 10 Flaw in Cloud SDK for Python Allowing OAuth2 Credential Theft
stories.description: Six SAP Cloud SDK for Python releases skip tenant checks in Destination calls, enabling OAuth2 client secret leaks if attackers control tenant names.

stories.title: TFG London Cyberattack Disrupts IT Systems Used by Phase Eight, Hobbs, and Whistles Brands
stories.description: TFG London has confirmed a cyberattack that disrupted IT systems supporting Phase Eight, Hobbs, and Whistles.

stories.title: Adobe Patches 140 Vulnerabilities Across 10 Products
stories.description: The flaws affect products such as Commerce, Photoshop, ColdFusion, Substance 3D, Dimension, FrameMaker and Bridge.

stories.title: Google Partially Reverses Chrome Bug Bounty Cuts
stories.description: Google is restructuring bug bounty rewards with a focus on complex memory safety vulnerabilities.

stories.title: Critical Docker Hub Flaw Lets Attackers Impersonate Users and Push Container Images
stories.description: Docker has disclosed a critical Docker Hub vulnerability that could let attackers impersonate other users and publish container images under trusted names.

stories.title: Meta Says Hackers Took Code, Personal Data of 1,500 in GitHub Breach
stories.description: Most of the affected individuals are Meta employees in the United States and they are being offered credit monitoring services.

stories.description: The Traffic Light Protocol (TLP)[1], which is now in its second incarnation, is a wonderful standard that enables one to easily communicate whether information may be shared further (and if so, how far).
